description: TwelveMonkeys common-image provides low-level image processing utilities shared across the TwelveMonkeys libraries, including buffered image creation, color model and color map handling, resampling/rescaling operators, dithering, and image filters built on Java's BufferedImageOp and ImageFilter APIs. It underpins the higher-level TwelveMonkeys ImageIO plugins by supplying reusable, format-agnostic image manipulation building blocks.
